subject: POC environment handover — logistics and timeline for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@velosys.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@velosys.io
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and POC setup asks

Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move into a short POC. Attached is our preferred mutual action plan (MAP_Velosys_v2.docx) with a proposed 3-week evaluation window. High level asks from our infra and procurement teams: 

- Redwood account/org setup: we need a single organization under Redwoods' hosted accounts that maps to our project for billing and RBAC.
- API keys & token lifecycle: steps to request API keys scoped to the POC project and guidance on rotation timelines.
- IP allowlist: our security team requires an allowlist of egress IPs or guidance on dynamic allowance (we prefer CIDR ranges).
- VPC peering: draft diagram for peering (we're on AWS us-west-2). The attached vpc-peering-draft.png is our current topology.

Can we set a 30-min sync on Tuesday to finalize the MAP and an exact cutover date? Procurement copied for contract/timing questions.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
VP Engineering, Velosys

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and POC setup asks

Samir —

Appreciate the clear MAP draft. Tuesday works for a short alignment; I suggested 10:00am PT on the calendar (please confirm). Initial notes:

- Org and billing: we can create a scoped org/project for Velosys in our hosted product and assign an owner-level contact for billing. Marissa (copy) will own the billing identifiers and HubSpot deal linkage.
- API keys: we have a standard seeding flow for POCs (one project-scoped key + capability-limited keys for integration). Karthik, can you prepare the one-page steps and recommended rotation schedule?
- IP allowlist: Hannah, we will need the minimal outbound egress CIDR and any NAT gateway constraints. If peering is used we can give you internal peer ranges and expected ports.
- VPC peering: please review Samir's diagram and propose any changes for the redwood endpoint side.

Next steps for the call: confirm final MAP signoff items, agree on an activation date (we aim for within two workdays after signoff), and list owners per task.

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@velosys.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Velosys POC — checklist and owners (please review before Tue call)

Team —

Following Samir's MAP and my reply, below is a concise owners list and deliverables to bring to Tuesday's sync. Please reply inline with any timing conflicts. I copied Samir to keep external visibility.

Owners & deliverables:
- Marissa Cole: Create hosted org entry for "Velosys-POC-VEL0" in billing console, return org_id and billing contact. Also attach HubSpot deal ID VELO-32471 to the org. ETA: EOD Mon.
- Karthik Iyer (SE): Draft API key provisioning doc (1 page) with: commands to create project-scoped key, recommended scopes for ingestion/generation, token rotation cadence, and sample minimal perms for service accounts. Also attach code snippet for curl and SDK. ETA: Tue 9:30am PT (pre-call).
- Hannah Schmitt (Infra): Produce IP allowlist guidance and the redwood-side egress CIDRs we require for the hosted endpoints. Provide VPC peering endpoint IPs and a short diagram modification suggestion for Samir to review. Also list port requirements (443, ICMP only if needed). ETA: Tue 9:30am PT (pre-call).

Technical notes to include on the call:
- We can provision a single project-scoped API key for their integration tests and a short-lived key for any partner tooling. Rotation: recommend 30-day rotation for short test keys, and 90-day for the seeded key used during the POC.
- VPC peering: Redwoods' hosted peering will require a single peering connection from Velosys' VPC (us-west-2) to our peering VPC; we will request a peer subnet allocation and pre-authorized route table entries on our side. If Velosys prefers private endpoints instead of peering we should list that as an alternate path.

Attachments to prepare for call: Karthik: api-key-quickstart.md (embed snippet) — Hannah: redwood-egress-cidrs.txt and peering-template.png — Marissa: org-create-confirmation.txt

Irene
